glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 言 + phonetic 吾. Part of a *ŋa- word family centred on "to face; to respond to": 御 (“to drive; to resist; to welcome; to attend upon”), 禦 (“to defend; to resist”), 圉 (“to guard; border”), 迓 (“to welcome; to meet in battle”), 逆 (“to meet; to oppose”), 晤 (“to meet face to face”), 忤 (“to go against”). The original sense was likely "to face someone with speech; speech directed at an interlocutor", as opposed to 言, which denotes the speech act itself. Compare Shuowen: 直言曰言，論難曰語.
shuowen: Compare Shuowen: 直言曰言，論難曰語.
senses: [yǔ] (of an animal) to chirp; to hoot
[yù] (obsolete in standard Chinese) to tell; to inform
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 語; s_page_origin explains the simplified 语.
